85a474e0f60c6d3f79487d0da94665408730ae64.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that Storm-3358, which it describes as a Cambodia-based intrusion cluster, began targeting financial organizations in October 2026 using the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX. Storm-3358 mainly targets financial organizations in Southeast Asia and a smaller number globally. The report says ARTEX agents combine with conventional tools to scan internet-facing systems, exploit flaws such as anonymous file upload and SSRF, and install open-source RATs (WISP, vshell, AdaptixC2) for persistence and lateral movement.
